description: When is the next US GDP release? Returns the next scheduled Gross Domestic Product release from the US Bureau of Economic Analysis calendar, saying which estimate it is (advance, second or third) and which quarter it covers, with the time in Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default), plus the two GDP releases after it. For traders, economists and anyone planning around the GDP print. It gives the schedule only, not the GDP figures or forecasts. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_gdp_release
